generation_procedure: Only during separately authorized RUN_ROUTE_A_GATE_H: verify v1.7 external SHA, Amendment007 SHA and every start guard; refuse any existing new-case/result/initialization/attempt008 destination.

Use importlib.util.spec_from_file_location/module_from_spec/exec_module to load the hash-guarded unchanged Scripts/routeA/generate_case.py without calling main automatically. Assign module.BETA=module.Decimal("1e-4") in memory only. No source edit; all other constants/functions remain unchanged.

Set sys.argv to [generator, --case-id, A-SMOKE, --name, A-H-Ra1e6-fine-beta1e-4, --nx, 160, --ny, 160, --ra, 1000000, --end-time, 3000] and call module.main(). This canonical main computes gravity from perturbed BETA and builds 0/p using canonical make_p with that same BETA. No baseline fields or mesh are copied.

Before any mesh or constructor/solver run, preserve the raw generated manifest as generated_manifest_original.json. The canonical template has literal beta 1e-3: require exactly one beta 1e-3; entry in NEW constant/physicalProperties, replace only its value with beta 1e-4;. Reject count!=1. This is the registered Gate H physical overlay on the newly generated case; canonical template is never edited.

Finalize NEW case_manifest.json: formal case_id, generator_role=A-SMOKE, attempt008, contract/version/hash, generator SHA, in-memory BETA override and exact overlay record; beta/g/Ra/Pr from actual dictionaries and formula. Recompute input_sha256 for all initial OpenFOAM inputs after overlay, excluding manifests/evidence files; preserve raw generator hashes separately. Freeze final input manifest before mesh. Raw generator physicalProperties hash is intermediate, not final authority.

Verify immutable properties, schemes, BC types, geometry and numerical values against the baseline/template; only beta and g are independent physical changes. Dependent initial 0/p is regenerated using p=rho*gh+pRef (internal rho0 at T0; wall EOS rho at Th/Tc), not warm-started. p_rgh remains canonical zero; pRef=hRef=0. Gate A recomputes Ra/Pr from actual inputs with existing 1e-10 relative criterion; mesh geometry must match baseline.

Then canonical blockMesh/checkMesh and existing isolated prepare_initialization_check.py + verify_initialization.py workflow, including its one-iteration constructor check, followed by runtime_provenance.py with v1.7. These are future execution operations, all prohibited during preparation.

One primary solution path: initial 3000, seal; D PASS -> accepted stop; normal finite D FAIL -> +3000 from same sealed latestTime, cap30000. Only startFrom/endTime continuation edits. STOP on evaluator, provenance, nonfinite, fatal, divergence or evidence corruption; no tuning, retry, cap extension, baseline rerun or extra grid.

Use unchanged canonical analyzer on the NEW sensitivity case only; snapshot metrics/raw monitors/logs/fields after every segment before continuation. Extract baseline comparisons from sealed historical metrics (read-only); do not route analyzer/postprocessing output into baseline directories.

Nu_monitor_identity.formal_definition: Nu_bar_0 = Q_hot/(k*DeltaT*W) = L/(DeltaT*A_hot) integral_hot dT/dn dA on uniform orthogonal wall
Nu_monitor_identity.area: A_hot=L*W; Q is area integral, not area-mean q or volume mean
Nu_monitor_identity.wall_convection: no-slip wall, normal convective flux zero; paper Nu_bar_0 at X=0 is conductive only
Nu_monitor_identity.legacy_pair_average: (Q_hot-Q_cold)/(2*k*DeltaT*W) retained only as legacy diagnostic, never formal Hard monitor
Nu_monitor_identity.path1: temperature/orthogonal wall-gradient snapshot remains independent primary final-value path; gate monitor uses calibrated official path2
Nu_monitor_identity.normalization_precision: same generated property values and k*DeltaT*W as canonical implementation, supplied via str(float) to rational monitor arithmetic

HEAT_TREND_PASS.input: original 17-significant-digit Q_hot/Q_cold decimal tokens from physical wallHeatFlux
HEAT_TREND_PASS.arithmetic: Python Fraction from original decimal Q tokens; exact rational normalization, centering, accumulation and sign
HEAT_TREND_PASS.source_precision: scientific tokens with >=16 digits after decimal; existing .16e has 17 significant digits; controlDict writePrecision 16 unchanged
HEAT_TREND_PASS.display: float slope is display only; heat_slope_sign_exact governs PASS/FAIL, including underflow-to-zero display
HEAT_TREND_PASS.ambiguity: missing/duplicate samples, nonfinite/low-precision Q, bad sign or parser error -> HEAT_TREND_EVALUATOR_UNRESOLVED / EVALUATOR_FAILURE and STOP; never use endpoints only or a positive epsilon

Gate_H.comparison_eligibility: Both baseline and perturbation computed/accepted with formal D PASS. Cap D FAIL -> computed YES accepted NO, formal H NOT_EVALUATED; optionally record separately labeled unaccepted diagnostics, never formal H promotion. Gate_H.scalar_metric: D_H(Q)=abs(Q_perturbed-Q_baseline)/abs(Q_baseline); save signed difference and signed relative difference separately. Nonzero baseline only; zero baseline -> null relative, absolute-only diagnostic, no invented threshold.
Gate_H.position_metric: signed coordinate difference and absolute coordinate difference on [0,1], no relative-percent interpretation or new Hard threshold.
Gate_H.epsilon_v_rule: perturbed reconstructed epsilon_v <= baseline reconstructed epsilon_v using same frozen Gauss-linear operator and normalization; no new rounding allowance or numerical slack
